eval: (()=>{ const t=document.querySelector('#gc-device .panel .kv').innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' | '); if(!t.includes('거부한 1박스도')) throw new Error('수량별 중재 안내 없음: '+t); return t; })()

(()=>{ const log=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#gc-log li')).slice(0,16).map(l=>l.innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' ')).join(' // '); if(!log.includes('25,604원')||!log.includes('NOTI_REFUND_DELAY_PAID')) throw new Error('거부 수량 인정 환불 25,604원·지연배상금 기록 없음: '+log); return log; })()
